name: com.soundiiz/soundiiz
title: Soundiiz
description: Official Soundiiz tools for tracklists, public playlist imports and music transfer compatibility.

tools.name: createSoundiizImportLink
tools.description: Create a temporary 24-hour Soundiiz import link for 1 to 200 supplied tracks. Show the exact returned shareUrl, including query parameters, and expiry. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. The user reviews the tracks and completes the transfer in Soundiiz. Omit unknown album or ISRC metadata. No music-service password or token is needed.

destination.description: Include only when the user requests a platform. Use the public slug returned by listSoundiizImportDestinations, such as apple-music or youtube-music. Existing Soundiiz corenames, such as applemusicapp or ytmusic, are also accepted. Otherwise omit this field.

artists.description: Artist names as an array; use an empty array when unknown.

tools.name: listSoundiizImportDestinations
tools.description: List configured destinations that can currently receive a Soundiiz playlist import link. Use the returned public slug across Soundiiz MCP tools. Existing corenames are also accepted; use corename for an import when slug is null. Does not access an account or check live service health.

tools.name: getSoundiizTransferCompatibility
tools.description: Check transfer and one-way playlist-sync capabilities between two platforms, including Soundiiz storage. Use public slugs, such as spotify and youtube-music, or existing Soundiiz corenames such as ytmusic and soundiiz. Return supported item types and human-readable web guide URLs from the cached platform catalog or configured Soundiiz storage capabilities. Show the exact returned guideUrl links, including query parameters, to users. This does not check account eligibility or live status. Results always use canonical public slugs.

source.description: Source public slug from https://soundiiz.com/capabilities.json, or soundiiz for Soundiiz storage. Existing Soundiiz corenames are also accepted; not a URL.

destination.description: Destination public slug, for example youtube-music, or soundiiz for Soundiiz storage. Existing Soundiiz corenames, such as ytmusic, are also accepted.

tools.name: createSoundiizImportLinkFromUrl
tools.description: Read a public playlist of at most 200 source items from its HTTPS URL and create a 24-hour Soundiiz import link. Supported sources: Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube, YouTube Music, Qobuz, TIDAL and public Soundiiz playlists. Supported short-link hosts: link.deezer.com, spotify.link, spotify.app.link, apple.co, on.soundcloud.com. Other short links and private playlists are unsupported. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. Show warnings, the exact shareUrl including query parameters, and expiry. The user reviews the tracks and connects the destination to complete the transfer in Soundiiz. No music-service password or user token is needed.

country.description: Optional two-letter catalog country for a TIDAL source, default US. Apple Music uses the storefront in its URL.

destination.description: Include only when the user requests a platform. Use the public slug returned by listSoundiizImportDestinations, such as apple-music or youtube-music. Existing Soundiiz corenames, such as applemusicapp or ytmusic, are also accepted. Otherwise omit this field.
